title: Brow Lamination vs. Brow Tinting: Which Should You Choose?
summary: Compare brow lamination and brow tinting based on results, cost, treatment time, longevity, and ideal candidates to choose the best option for your brow needs now.
body_markdown:
The list of ways to achieve perfect brows keeps growing. We pluck, thread, wax, shape, fill, and trim. And we get it—great brows are a huge confidence booster. Brow lamination is one of the newer techniques to join the lineup, and you may be wondering how it stacks up against methods like


[brow tinting](https://waxcenter.com/blogs/news/what-is-brow-tinting?) .


****


So, which is better for you, brow tinting or brow lamination? We’re breaking down how they work, who they’re for, and how these two


[eyebrow treatments](https://waxcenter.com/blogs/news/know-all-your-options-for-eyebrow-treatments) compare against one another.


****


## What is Brow Lamination?


Brow lamination is a non-invasive beauty solution that uses a chemical lifting cream to straighten, tame, and shape your brows. Some people describe it as a “perm” for your eyebrows. Laminated eyebrows are known for having very crisp, clean lines and a sleek, “brushed up” look.


The biggest advantage of having laminated eyebrows is that they’re low-maintenance and can be styled within minutes. Because the treatment reshapes your natural hair and makes it more manageable, most people only take a few seconds to brush their brows back into place after waking up.


The process is pain-free, and the results last around eight weeks.


## How Does Brow Lamination Work?


****


Brow lamination uses a chemical cream for brow smoothing and shaping. The cream softens hair, allowing a technician to easily manipulate brow shape, then set them in place for a more polished look.


The process is usually completed in four steps:


****


1.


**Tame.**


As the first step in brow lamination, a lifting cream is applied for brow smoothing. This straightens the hair and makes it easier to manipulate into the desired shape.


2.


**Shape** .


A technician will use a brush or spoolie to shape brows.


3.


**Set.**


A neutralizer is applied to help deactivate the lifting cream and set the brows in their new shape.


4.


**Hydrate.** An oil is applied to help prevent skin irritation and dryness from the lifting cream.


### How long does brow lamination take?


How long brow lamination takes depends on where you get it done and how experienced your technician is, but on average, it takes between 30 and 45 minutes.


### How long does brow lamination last?


Brow lamination lasts eight weeks on average. Doing it more often than this can risk over-lamination and damage your eyebrow hair.


### How much does brow lamination cost?


The cost of brow lamination depends on the location and the technician’s experience, but the average is $80-$120.


## Who Should Avoid Brow Lamination?


There are certain disadvantages to brow lamination, and it may not be for everyone.


### Brow lamination is not ideal for sparse brows.


If your concern is sparse brows, brow lamination isn't necessarily the best option. Because no color is applied, gaps can still be visible and may even be emphasized by lamination.


### Lifting cream may be unsuitable for sensitive skin.


The cream used during brow lamination can be drying or irritating, especially for sensitive skin.


### Lamination can weaken brows over time.


Because brow lamination chemically alters the hair, repeating the treatment too frequently can weaken or damage your brows. If your hair is dry, brittle, or sparse, you may want to skip this one. If you do choose lamination, it’s important to wait the recommended amount of time between appointments and have the treatment performed by an experienced professional.


### Laminated brows may not be for those who prefer a natural look.


Laminated brows can sometimes look unnatural. If this isn’t your speed, and you prefer more of a “your brows, but better” look, try a brow tint instead.


## What is Brow Tinting?


****


Brow tinting involves dyeing eyebrows using an FDA-approved, semipermanent dye for fuller, bolder brows. It can be completed in just five minutes and lasts 3-4 weeks. You can choose from different shades of dye to match your brow color, so the overall look is very natural.


### **** Brow tinting is better for sparse brows.


If gaps in your brows are bothering you and what you’re after is a fuller, bolder look with more definition,


[brow tinting is a better option](https://waxcenter.com/pages/brow-tint#:~:text=How%20Do%20I%20Know%20If%20Eyebrow%20Tinting%20Is%20For%20Me%3F) . It uses a dye that matches your natural brow color to fill in gaps.


### Brow tinting is often considered more natural-looking.


For those who prefer a “your brows, but better” look, brow tinting is the perfect solution. European Wax Center offers four universal shades to match your natural brow color.


### Brow tinting is faster than brow lamination.


If you’re someone who gets beauty treatments done regularly but still has places to be, you’ll love the speed of eyebrow tinting. The service can be completed in just five minutes—either on its own or as an


[add-on during your wax appointment](https://waxcenter.com/pages/brow-tint) . One stop, two things checked off your to-do list.


### Brow tinting is cheaper than brow lamination.


The cost of brow tinting can vary depending on location, but one session is $20-$30 on average.


## Which is Better, Brow Tint or Brow Lamination?


****


While lamination focuses mainly on shape, brow tinting has an edge when it comes to making your brows look fuller. Some salons offer brow tinting and lamination together.


**Brow Tinting** **Brow Lamination**


**Ideal for** Fuller, more define-looking brows Taming and reshaping brow hair


**Look** Natural. "Your brows, but better." Sleek brushed-up polished


**Treatment time** ~5 minutes ~30-45 minutes


**Results last** ~3-4 weeks ~8 weeks


**Average cost** $20-$30 $80-$120


## What’s the Bottom Line?


****


Brow lamination and brow tinting are both tried and trusted beauty solutions for an easier daily routine. Which you choose depends on your desired outcome, budget, lifestyle, and goals.


Brow lamination is a good option if your goal is to tame unruly hairs and achieve a crisp, defined shape. Think of it this way: if you love the way a brow pomade shapes and sets your brows after you brush them up, you’ll probably love laminated eyebrows.


****


If your concern is sparse brows or you have larger gaps, brow tinting is a better option for adding fullness. It’s a faster, more convenient treatment, and it creates a very natural-looking effect that some people prefer.
